title: Pirate Brawl - A dream come through by LLMs
author: KptEmreU
selftext:
I used AI, and I will use it again. There is zero chance I could finish this hobby game without the hand-holding of AI (Used Chatgpt (20USD) , Codex when both failed Free Claude). I spent a lot of time on this POC. I did throw away concepts, lots of code and learned a ton about Fusion2 and multiplayer game building (I have some posts about it too). And only 4 people played the game so far... But whatever! I am here. Gonna polish my game further. Even bought 1 month of CapCut for these stupid promo videos. Yes, I am editing them myself...   
Also, I used Photopea and some Blender.   
  
To all sceptics, these are tools! Should I first invent the pencil?

The game is on [itch.io](http://itch.io) and Gamejolt. I desperately need more feedback if you have time. 1 match is less than 5 minutes. I bet you play more than 1 match :D Even if you are solo.

comments.author: KptEmreU
comments.body: And with Capcut looks like I export at 480p... Welp. There goes one promo chance :)

comments.author: HitMePat
comments.body: I'm proud of you OP.   It looks really good.  How did you learn to animate the ships?  Did you have experience with 3D modeling prior to AI?  I'm working on a 3D game and getting great results but not nearly as professional looking as yours

replies.author: KptEmreU
replies.body:
Thanks a lot for your kind feedback. Yes, I played a lot with Blender and have old games that I made with Unity3d, pre-ai times too. Actually, in Gamejolt, you can see an older version of the game by done by me. Like very, very old + no multiplayer. ( [https://gamejolt.com/games/battle-for-ale/79562](https://gamejolt.com/games/battle-for-ale/79562) ) But I prefer if you visit my recent one and download and play ( [https://gamejolt.com/games/piratebrawl/1064457](https://gamejolt.com/games/piratebrawl/1064457) ) 

Animation of ships was not that hard btw, I just let them pitch and roll when the user input is pressed. They are not real animations :D They are just some smoothing... and I did them with ChatGPT. Told them when the ship is turning left, the ship's top side should roll to the right! ofc it spit an awesome script for it.  If you are talking about the drift of the ships, yeah, I am an old sailor I think it adds up too :)   
  
I think this is what I will do when I retire from my job...

If you ever need an eye for a feedback, I would be grateful to return the favour.
